_om: Tankeleseren in English (Mind Reader, rusj.no/en/mind-reader/): one hint, one dial. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js (two keys keep the no-break spaces of the code). The scales are in data.en/spektrum.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Dere deler visst én hjerne. Litt skummel: You must share one brain. Slightly spooky, really.
Imponerende! Dere tenker nesten helt lik: Impressive! You think almost exactly alike.
Litt støy på linja, men dere hører hvera: A bit of static, but you can hear each other.
Signalet kommer og går. En runde til?: The signal comes and goes. One more round?
Dere sender på helt ulike kanaler. Prøv: You're broadcasting on completely different channels. Try again!
Vis målet på skiva: Show the target on the dial
Eksempel: Kaldt ↔ Varmt, målet litt mot: Example: Cold ↔ Hot, target a little towards hot → ‘bath water’.
Vennen din ser skalaen og hintet – ikke: Your friend sees the scale and the hint – not the target. Feel free to share it with more people!
Your friend sees the scale and the hint – not the target.
Bare du skal se. Slipp, så skjules målet: Only you should look. Let go and the target hides again.
Skriv ett hint som hører hjemme akkurat: Write one hint that belongs exactly where the target is
Si ett hint som hører hjemme akkurat der: Say one hint that belongs exactly where the target is
Hold again as often as you like.
Hold litt lenger for å se målet: Hold a little longer to see the target
Hold fingeren her for å se: Hold your finger here to see
Tap a name to switch teams.
Each team needs at least two players.
Én ser et hemmelig mål på skiva og gir e: One player sees a secret target on the dial and gives one hint. The others try to read their mind – and drag the needle to where they think the target is.
Hintgiveren holder inne på skiva og ser: The hint giver holds the dial and sees where the target lies between the two ends of the card.
Si noe som hører hjemme akkurat der. Eks: Say something that belongs exactly there. Example: Cold ↔ Hot, target a little towards hot – ‘bath water’.
De andre diskuterer og drar viseren dit: The others talk it over and drag the needle to where they think it is. Lock it in. The closer to the centre, the more points (4, 3 or 2).
Ikke si tall, prosent eller «litt til ve: No numbers, percentages or ‘a bit to the left’. Just the hint!
Passer ikke skalaen? Hintgiveren har to: Scale doesn't suit you? The hint giver has two to choose from – ‘Switch to’ at the bottom of the screen swaps them.
Skriv gjerne hintet i feltet over skiva,: Type the hint in the box above the dial if you like, so everyone remembers what was said.
Sammen: åtte runder, og alle bytter på å: Together: eight rounds, and everyone takes a turn giving the hint. How many of 32 points can you get? The phone remembers the record.
Lag mot lag: når det ene laget har låst: Team v team: when one team has locked in, the other can guess whether the target is left or right of the needle. A right guess scores 1 point.
Lag mot lag: får et lag full pott (4 poe: Team v team: a team that scores full marks (4 points) and is still behind gets another round.
Send en utfordring: lag en skive med ett: Send a challenge: make a dial with one hint and send the link to a friend.
Viseren kan også flyttes med ◀ ▶ eller p: You can also move the needle with ◀ ▶ or the arrow keys.
Er dere på samme bølgelengde?: Are you on the same page?
Lagene settes opp under. Alle bytter på: Set up the teams below. Everyone takes a turn giving the hint.
Én runde per spiller – alle gir hint én: One round per player – everyone gives the hint once.
Everyone takes a turn giving the hint.
Ekstrarunde: {lag} gir hint igjen: Extra round: {lag} give the hint again
Bare hintgiveren ser skiva nå: Only the hint giver sees the dial now
Listen to the hint from {navn} and drag the needle.
Ligger målet til venstre eller høyre for: Is the target left or right of the needle? A right guess scores 1 point.
Målet var ved {mal}, viseren sto ved {vi: The target was at {mal}, the needle was at {viser}
Dere rakk ikke å låse noe svar denne gan: You didn't get to lock in an answer this time. Ready for another round?
Første runde – nå har dere en rekord å s: First game – now you've got a record to beat!
Se målet, skriv ett hint og send den til: See the target, write one hint and send it to a friend.
En venn tenker på dette et sted mellom d: A friend is thinking of this, somewhere between the two. Drag the needle to where you think it is.
The scale now goes from ‘{a}’ to ‘{b}’.
Dere går til kåringen. Laget som leder n: You'll go to the results. The team in the lead now wins.
Dere går til kåringen med poengene dere: You'll go to the results with the points you have now.
Jeg tenker på «{hint}» et sted mellom «{: I'm thinking of ‘{hint}’, somewhere between ‘{a}’ and ‘{b}’. Can you hit it?
